framing: SocraticEngine is a Swift Package — the macOS bust .app is one of N consumers, not the product. The product is the package.
target_persona: Swift developers building the next host app (CLI tools, visionOS bust, Shortcuts action, Raycast extension, third-party note apps) who want a 100% on-device Korean Socratic engine they can drop in via SwiftPM in three lines. Judges read the SDK framing as technical-execution proof that He Was Socrates is a reusable engine, not a one-off macOS demo.

SwiftPM dependency line + 10-line minimal Swift consumer + full public API surface table (EngineCoordinator / Phase / FunctionCallOrchestrator / TTSManager / AudioInputManager / TurnOutput / Mode / VisemeID) + three example consumer cards (macOS bust, socrates CLI, visionOS bust marked designed-for) + NO-CLOUD compliance receipt.
